notes:
September 2nd 2026
Version 13.7+ (stable) / 13.8+ (beta)
**********************
NEW!
* Drum links now carry across between the FR-8x and FR-4x. (R)
* Much smaller download and install - the guides now come from the web. (K,R)
* Reed sliders now show which reeds the chosen register has switched off. (R)
* See Help->Show Release Notes for More...
notes_beta:
September 2nd 2026
Version 13.7+ (stable) / 13.8+ (beta)
**********************
NEW!
* Drum links now carry across between the FR-8x and FR-4x. (R)
* Much smaller download and install - the guides now come from the web. (K,R)
* Reed sliders now show which reeds the chosen register has switched off. (R)
* Silent orchestra registers (empty effect settings) are now repaired automatically on open and on import. (R)
* Importing a .UPB/.UPG asks once which accordion made it, so drum kits and links convert correctly. (R)
* Integrity Check now finds - and repairs - programs whose orchestra sound plays nothing. (R)
* See Help->Show Release Notes for More...
